passwordPolicy: length(14) and maxLength(128) and upperCase(1) and lowerCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername and notEmail and passwordHistory(12) and forceExpiredPasswordChange(90)

profiles.name: fbx-service-client-baseline
profiles.description: Machine-to-machine clients: client credentials only, no browser or password grants, no full scope. No client-x509: TLS ends at the mesh, Keycloak never sees a client certificate.

profiles.name: fbx-staff-sso
profiles.description: Confidential staff SSO clients (Grafana): authorization code with PKCE S256, no implicit or password grant.

profiles.name: fbx-open-finance-tpp-client-auth
profiles.description: Open-finance TPPs authenticate with private_key_jwt only (added to the built-in FAPI 2.0 DPoP profile, which would also allow tls_client_auth; TLS ends at the gateway, so Keycloak never sees a client certificate).

profiles.name: fbx-first-party-public
profiles.description: OAuth 2.1 public clients (web, mobile): PKCE S256, no implicit or password grant, strict redirect URIs. DPoP is not required for first-party clients yet (platform contract addendum 2026-10-08).

policies.name: fbx-service-clients
policies.description: Applies the service client baseline to every client tagged fbx.client-type=service.

policies.name: fbx-staff-sso-clients
policies.description: Applies the staff SSO profile to clients tagged fbx.client-type=staff-sso.

policies.name: fbx-first-party-public-clients
policies.description: Applies OAuth 2.1 public-client rules to web and mobile clients.

policies.name: fbx-open-finance-tpp-fapi2-dpop
policies.description: FAPI 2.0 Security Profile with DPoP sender-constrained tokens (PAR, PKCE, private_key_jwt client auth, PS256) for open-finance TPP clients. DPoP is the only token binding: TLS ends at the gateway (SIMPLE) and Keycloak runs behind plain HTTP, so mTLS-bound tokens cannot work.

policies.name: fbx-open-finance-tpp-dynamic-registration
policies.description: TPP onboarding through Dynamic Client Registration (initial or registration access token) must already satisfy FAPI 2.0 + DPoP at registration time; the client-attributes conditions only match once the client exists.
